user.title: Proxmox Datacenter Manager
user.description:
Connect to your Proxmox Datacenter Manager instance.

API Token ID format: {api_token_format}

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of your PDM server
data_description.api_token_secret: The secret value of your API token
data_description.verify_ssl: Enable to verify the SSL certificate

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Please enter your new API token credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to PDM server

abort.already_configured: This PDM instance is already configured

init.title: Sensor Configuration
init.description: Configure which sensors to create. Note: Enabling VM sensors may create many entities.

data_description.node_sensors: Create CPU and memory sensors for each Proxmox node
data_description.vm_sensors: Create status sensors for virtual machines (may create many entities)
data_description.vm_filter: Regular expression to filter VMs by name (e.g., 'prod-.*' or '(web|db)-.*'). Leave empty for all VMs.

migrate_vm.name: Migrate VM
migrate_vm.description: Migrate a virtual machine to a target host

vm_name.name: VM Name
vm_name.description: The name of the virtual machine to migrate

target_host.name: Target Host
target_host.description: The target node/host to migrate the VM to

target_remote.name: Target Remote
target_remote.description: The target remote/cluster for cross-cluster migrations (leave empty for same-cluster)

with_local_disks.name: With Local Disks
with_local_disks.description: Include local disks in the migration

start_vm.name: Start VM
start_vm.description: Start a virtual machine by name

vm_name.name: VM Name
vm_name.description: The name of the virtual machine to start

stop_vm.name: Stop VM
stop_vm.description: Stop a virtual machine by name

vm_name.name: VM Name
vm_name.description: The name of the virtual machine to stop

shutdown_vm.name: Shutdown VM
shutdown_vm.description: Gracefully shutdown a virtual machine by name

vm_name.name: VM Name
vm_name.description: The name of the virtual machine to shutdown

shutdown_host_vms.name: Shutdown Host VMs
shutdown_host_vms.description: Gracefully shutdown all running VMs on a specific host

host_name.name: Host Name
host_name.description: The name of the Proxmox host/node whose VMs should be shutdown

remote_name.name: Remote Name
remote_name.description: The remote/cluster name (optional if host name is unique)

shutdown_remote_vms.name: Shutdown Remote VMs
shutdown_remote_vms.description: Gracefully shutdown all running VMs on a specific remote/cluster

remote_name.name: Remote Name
remote_name.description: The remote/cluster name whose VMs should be shutdown

host_name.name: Host Name
host_name.description: The name of the Proxmox host/node to shutdown

remote_name.name: Remote Name
remote_name.description: The remote/cluster name (optional if host name is unique)

shutdown_all_hosts.name: Shutdown All Hosts
shutdown_all_hosts.description: Shutdown all hosts in a remote/cluster, skipping hosts already offline

remote_name.name: Remote Name
remote_name.description: The remote/cluster name whose hosts should be shutdown

reset_migration_state.name: Reset Migration State
reset_migration_state.description: Reset the migration state sensor to idle

list_vms.name: List VMs
list_vms.description: List all VMs and containers discovered by PDM (useful for debugging)

debug_api.name: Debug API
debug_api.description: Inspect raw API responses from PDM (useful for troubleshooting)
